name: Caustic Soda Flakes
summary: Sodium hydroxide in flake form for neutralisation, cleaning and soap and detergent manufacturing.
description: Caustic soda flakes are a strong alkali supplied in free-flowing flake form, easy to dose and dissolve on site.
Widely used for pH correction, saponification, industrial cleaning and as a raw material in textile and chemical processing.

name: Soda Ash Light
summary: Sodium carbonate (light grade) for glass, detergents, textiles and water treatment.
description: Soda ash light is a fine, free-flowing grade of sodium carbonate with low bulk density.
It is used as a pH regulator and alkali source across glass, detergent and textile applications.

name: Hydrochloric Acid 33%
summary: Commercial-grade hydrochloric acid for pickling, pH control and chemical processing.
description: Hydrochloric acid is a strong mineral acid supplied as an aqueous solution.
Common uses include steel pickling, regeneration of ion-exchange resins, pH control and the manufacture of chlorides.

name: Sulphuric Acid 98%
summary: Concentrated sulphuric acid for fertiliser, metal treatment and chemical manufacturing.
description: Sulphuric acid is one of the most widely used industrial chemicals, supplied here in concentrated form.
It serves as a raw material and process chemical across fertiliser, metal processing and chemical industries.

name: Isopropyl Alcohol
summary: High-purity isopropanol for cleaning, disinfection, extraction and formulation.
description: Isopropyl alcohol is a fast-evaporating solvent with excellent cleaning properties.
It is used in pharmaceutical, electronics and coatings applications and as an extraction and formulation solvent.

name: Acetone
summary: Versatile, fast-drying solvent for coatings, adhesives, cleaning and extraction.
description: Acetone is a highly effective solvent that mixes freely with water and many organic solvents.
It is used for cleaning, degreasing, thinning coatings and as a process solvent in pharmaceutical manufacturing.
